description: Scan the HTTP security headers of a public website. Returns a 0–100 score and A+–F grade (HTTPS 10, HSTS 15, CSP 25, framing 10, X-Content-Type-Options 10, Referrer-Policy 10, Permissions-Policy 5, COOP 5, CORP 5, cookies 5, minus up to 5 for version-leak headers; without HTTPS the score is capped at 39), each header's status and notes, recommended fix headers, and a link to the full report with copy-paste snippets for nginx, Apache, Cloudflare, Netlify, Vercel and Express. Read-only: it sends ordinary GET requests to the site (following up to 10 redirects, each safety-checked) and never reads page bodies. Same engine and scoring as the HeaderGuard JSON API (GET /api/scan).

include_raw.description: Also return the full /api/scan JSON (redirect chain, all response headers with cookie values redacted, per-platform fix snippets) in structuredContent.raw. Larger output.

url.description: URL or bare domain to scan, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/login. A bare domain is scanned as https://<domain>/ (plain HTTP if HTTPS does not answer).

name: scan_headers

id.description: https, hsts, csp, framing, xcto, referrer, permissions, coop, corp, cookies, coep, xxss or leaks

header.description: Header to send (omitted for non-header fixes such as the HTTPS redirect)

grade.description: Omitted when the grade is withheld

gradeWithheld.description: true when the site blocked, rate-limited or challenged the scanner

raw.description: Full /api/scan response (only when include_raw is true)

score.description: Omitted when the grade is withheld

title: Scan a website's HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, framing, COOP/CORP/COEP, cookies)
